title: Junior Graphic Designers
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Conceptualize and design visually appealing graphics for various platforms, including social media posts, banners, flyers, and print materials. Your designs should align with the brand's identity and target audience.
* Collaborate with the design team to ensure consistency and quality in our work. You will work closely with other designers, copywriters, and marketing professionals to create cohesive and effective designs.
* Create mockups and wireframes to present design concepts to clients. You will use design tools to visualize and communicate your ideas, helping clients understand how their designs will look and function.
* Develop and refine design assets based on feedback and client requirements. You will be responsible for making necessary adjustments to your designs to meet client expectations and ensure they are visually appealing and effective.
* Pitch creative ideas to contribute to innovative design solutions. You will be expected to come up with fresh and original design concepts that help our clients achieve their marketing goals.

**Qualifications**

* 3-4 years of experience working as a Junior Graphic Designer, UI Designer, or a similar role.
* Experience with design software (e.g. InVision) and graphics editing tools (e.g. Photoshop, CorelDRAW)
* Familiarity with design techniques (e.g. prototyping)
* Understanding of visual elements (layout, type and fonts).
* Bachelor's degree in Arts, Graphic Design, or a similar field.

title: Senior Network Solution Designer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Network Solution Designer to join the Access Networks organization. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise and service‑provider‑grade network infrastructures. The role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, network segmentation, L2/L3 services, wireless infrastructure, and architectural design. The candidate must operate effectively both independently and within distributed global teams.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Develop detailed High-Level and Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for routing, switching, segmentation, Wi‑Fi, and NAC-enabled environments
* Design scalable enterprise and service provider network architecture
* Evaluate architecture changes, define resiliency requirements, and ensure alignment to Nokia standards.
* Analyze and resolve complex production network issues while ensuring reliable service operation for both Wired and Wireless network services.
* Administer service requests, execute network changes, and manage escalated incidents or priority incidents end-to-end.
* Collaborate with cross-technology teams to provide timely updates and coordinate incident resolutions.
* Identify root causes of network incidents and develop preventive actions while adhering to change management processes.
* Design and deploy wireless networks and authentication solutions, ensuring compliance with security best practices.
* Act as a L3 escalation point for L2 team members and mentor junior team members while staying updated on industry trends in network security technologies.
* Drive results and foster a strong customer focus in a dynamic, global team environment to maintain SLA compliance.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent with 12+ years of experience in network services within complex environments
* Deep knowledge in Network Routing, Switching, design/configuration in Local Area Networks.
* Proficiency in authentication protocols like RADIUS, TACACS, and LDAP
* Proficiency in OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VRRP and MPLS network protocols,VPLS, VPRN and VLL services
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and network technologies and Engineer network resilience, redundancy and optimized traffic flows.

**Nice-To-Have**

* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools for network management
* Experience in configuration and management of Clearpass & NAC
* WLAN knowledge specifically with Aruba Access Points and Controllers
* SROS Nokia Service Router Experience

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Junior UXUI Designer
company: iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited
description:
**Company Description**
iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited is an algorithm development company focused on delivering innovative solutions for the oil and gas industry. The organization leverages data-driven approaches and advanced computational methods to solve complex industrial challenges. Team members collaborate closely with domain experts to design technology that improves efficiency, safety, and decision-making. The work environment supports learning, experimentation, and professional growth for individuals interested in applied technology and design.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Junior UXUI Designer role based in Velachery. The Junior UXUI Designer will support the design of user interfaces for web and desktop applications used in the oil and gas industry. Day-to-day tasks include creating wireframes, visual designs, and interactive prototypes, collaborating with product managers and developers to translate complex workflows into intuitive user experiences. The role involves conducting basic user research, organizing feedback, refining designs based on stakeholder input, and ensuring consistency in layout, typography, and visual elements. The Junior UXUI Designer will also assist in maintaining design systems and preparing assets for development handoff.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in UX and UI design principles, including wireframing, prototyping, and information architecture.
* Proficiency with common design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar).
* Ability to conduct and synthesize basic user research, usability feedback, and user testing outcomes.
* Attention to detail in visual design, layout, typography, and interaction design.
* Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with product, development, and domain experts.
* Relevant educational background in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Interest in learning about industrial domains such as oil and gas, and in designing for complex data-driven applications.
* Capability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and adapt to evolving project requirements in an on-site team environment.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**
BETA is a dynamic, product-based software company focused on building high-performance digital solutions for both individuals and enterprises. The company designs, develops, and launches a diverse suite of proprietary applications, ranging from intuitive tools for everyday users to scalable platforms for large organizations. With a strong emphasis on technical excellence and human-centric design, BETA prioritizes immediate value and exceptional user experience in every product. Its software is built to be powerful, secure, and accessible, enabling users and businesses to streamline tasks and workflows effectively.
  
**Role Description**
The Junior Graphic Designer role at BETA is a full-time, on-site position based in Tiruvallur. This role involves creating visual assets for digital and print materials, including marketing campaigns, product interfaces, social media content, and internal communications. The Junior Graphic Designer will collaborate with senior designers, product teams, and marketing specialists to translate concepts and brand guidelines into clear, engaging visuals. Daily tasks include preparing design drafts, refining layouts, selecting typography, and adjusting graphics based on feedback. The role also includes maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs and supporting ongoing design projects from concept to final delivery.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Graphic Design and creating high-quality Graphics for digital and print media.
* Ability to design Logos and support Branding initiatives across products and marketing materials.
* Good understanding of Typography and layout principles for clear, readable, and visually appealing designs.
* Proficiency with industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma or similar software).
* Portfolio demonstrating creative work, attention to detail, and ability to follow brand guidelines.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, accept constructive feedback, and meet deadlines.
* Relevant education in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Basic knowledge of digital product design or UI assets creation is a plus.

title: Technical Project Executive – Web & E-commerce
description:

 We’re looking for a Technical Project Executive who can take complete responsibility for our website and e\-commerce projects.
   

  

 We need someone who can build, troubleshoot, deploy and make projects LIVE — not someone who only completes development tasks.
   

  

 What You'll Be Responsible For
   

  

 \- Develop and customise WordPress websites

 \- Implement basic technical SEO requirements

 Once a project is assigned to you, you are responsible for taking it through:
   

  

 Requirement → Development → Testing → Fixes → Deployment → LIVE
   

  

 You should be comfortable investigating problems independently and finding solutions instead of waiting for someone else to solve them.

 CV \+ Portfolio \+ Live Websites You Have Worked On

 Digital Yugam
